reviews.text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Vincenzo is the one and only! A true spectacle! After a terrible experience with another groomer who even tried to scam me by pretending to be him, I finally took my poodle to Exotic Life Beauty & SPA. What can I say... Vincenzo did a truly spectacular job! The cut is perfect, with attention to every detail, and my dog's fur has never looked so beautiful. The professionalism, love, and honesty that Vincenzo puts into his work are unparalleled. Beware of imitations and those who try to steal his professional identity: the true talent and care you find here are unique. Highly recommended, we will definitely always return to him.

A full-fledged spa.
Professional and animal-loving.
Cookie's first experience at your spa. Everything was perfect, from the welcome to the cut, as requested! It's a shame it's so far away, but I'll definitely be back! Thanks, Vincenzo.
They're very good. My Otto goes there without any fuss and comes back beautiful.

A super positive experience for my two Westies... spa treatment, bath, and haircut, and they were pampered and happy.
Highly recommended.

I'm giving it 5 stars because it's the best I can give.
I sincerely thank Vincenzo Castaldi, his wife Alessia, and his staff for their kindness and truly top-notch professionalism in providing the requested service.
I took advantage of a pleasure trip to Naples to have my Maltese, Happy, groomed in Asian style. The result was truly exceptional. Precision and extreme attention to every detail.
I highly recommend it to anyone seeking a quality grooming service. The salon also offers the option of purchasing cosmetics for at-home grooming of your pet, as well as beautiful accessories.
The best groomer we've ever been to ♥️ Perfect cut - we're more than happy.

The best poodle grooming and bathing experience in town. Vincenzo and his staff are a sure bet. The products used during treatments are excellent, and they are courteous and professional in every aspect of dog care. The shuttle service, which picks up and drops off your dog by appointment, is very helpful. I've been entrusting Fragile to them for over a year now, and I couldn't be more satisfied and happy. True professionals.
Mila, just like us, was thrilled with her exotic life experience and will definitely be back.
I recommend him for his professionalism, competence, punctuality and kindness.

A true beauty salon for our furry friends
Excellent quality products
Highly recommended

I went to your center a few days ago for my little dog. Congratulations on the salon, which feels like a real spa, and especially on the helpfulness and professionalism of the guy who welcomed us, Federico, who took care of my Pilu'. Perfect, fragrant grooming. I highly recommend it.
My Pomeranian puppy came out beautiful! 🥰 I came from Mantua and couldn't wait to bring him here to them! …

Perfect grooming. For me they are the best, for work reasons out of town I took my dog ​​to others and I assure you they ruined the whole cut. I finally went back to them and they are the absolute best.
